text: Anyone able to do sat counter? Mrs okafor's mince pies need collecting before 10 and she's having people round
On dough from 4am sat, can't do counter as well
I can do 8 till 1 if nobody else. Got a shift at the petrol station after
8 till 1 is ok but who does 1 onwards
Not me, sorry. Could we do okafor's on fri instead?
She's collecting sat 🙁
Sorry was on the bus. So 8-1 is fine for me, still need the afternoon
I'll ask Pete if he's still on for the afternoon. Might swap with him
Thanks
Pete says yes but he wants sunday off in return. I said I'd ask
Morning. Asked the boss about sun cover, she says she'll look at the rota after lunch
Ok thanks. Is pete ok to do sat aft if he gets sun off or does he want the whole weekend
Don't know, he's not answering. Probably on the bus
I'm on the till till 1 today if anyone needs me to ask sarah abt sat
Okafor's order is 2 dozen mince, 1 box stollen, and she wants the iced ones not the plain. Writing it on the sheet so whoever does sat has it
[photo: order sheet]
Pete's back on. Says he can't do sun but he'll do sat 1 onwards if we pay him back the Friday after christmas
I've said I'll check. Dunno who has the keys to the back
Off the petrol station. My feet are dead
Also is anyone doing sat 1 onwards or is it still open
Still open. Sarah says she'll do it if nobody else but she's got her mum's
I can do sat aft if I finish the Hendersons cake by then. It's a 3 tier so no promises
Put you down for sat 1 then, Laura. Thank you
Ok sat 8-1 me then, Laura 1 onwards. Nice one
Hendersons is done, they've gone to collect it
Anyone else up? Pete says sun is sorted but he's still bitter about it
Im up. Cant sleep. The mince pie stuff for sat is written down right
Good. Sarah has the back keys, I'll ask her to leave them with the boss
Morning. Is anyone on the counter this morning or is it just Sarah
Just Sarah till 1 I think. I'm in the back doing the tree cakes all day
College till 10 then in. Sarah's fine on her own
Boss says she'll do sun cover by Friday. Pete's happy
Who's got the stollen order? Mrs O wants to know if it's 1 or 2 boxes
1 box, it's on the sheet. Photo above
Oh yeah sorry
Going on lunch. Is the 2 dozen iced or plain or do I just check the sheet
Iced its on the sheet
Two more orders in since lunch, both for the 19th. Putting them in the book
[photo: order book page]
Off the bus. Who's on the rota for the 19th
Not done yet, boss has it. Will say when it's up
Anyone seen the big mixer lid? Think it's in the back
Under the bench by the sink, has been since Friday 🙄
